eval.description: OpenAI multiple-choice biorisk tacit-knowledge and troubleshooting set built with Gryphon Scientific. Items target hands-on and hard-to-look-up knowledge across stages of biological threat creation. Scored as accuracy (and consensus@k on some cards), with expert consensus and 80th-percentile PhD baselines; some reports treat refusals as passes. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model knows hands-on, hard-to-find lab details that could help someone create biological threats.
